title: Lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology
bio: Dr. Eleana Stoufi completed her postgraduate studies in oral medicine and oral pathology at Harvard School of Dental Medicine (HSDM). She is a part-time lecturer at the School and an honorary associate professor at the University of Rwanda. She is the head of the Oral Medicine Department at the Euroclinic Hospital in Athens and has been a scientific associate at University of Athens' Dental School. Stoufi served as the scientific director of a two-year program for oral cancer prevention sponsored by the EU, the Greek Ministry of Health, and the Greek Dental Association from 2015 to 2016. Since 2019, she has been a member of the National Committee of the Greek Ministry of Health for a strategic campaign against smoking. In 2020, she was elected Secretary of the Scientific Committee of the Greek Dental Association. Additionally, she has been an external contributor to the FDI Tobacco Cessation Project Task Team since 2022. Stoufi is the co-author of the book Pocket Atlas of Oral Diseases (2019) in Greek and the co-author of the second edition of Periodontal Manifestations of Local and Systemic Diseases (2023) in English by Springer.
